ability.name: Soar
ability.note: This Pokémon [CTRL NOTE][on the field] can fly over Pokémon that don't have [CTRL QL Soar][Soar] using an MP move. If this Pokémon has a Charge marker, it gains +1 MP and deals +30 damage.

wheel.name: Roost
wheel.note: This Pokémon recovers from all status effects. In exchange, it must then Wait 3.

wheel.name: Flame Charge
wheel.note: This Pokémon gains a Charge marker. You may remove the Charge marker at the start of your turn. On the turn in which the Charge marker is removed, this Pokémon instead of attacking, may cause an adjacent opposing Pokémon and Pokémon in a straight line behind it to become burned (without attacking). If it does, your turn ends.
